title: Review Grace Days — Tenure Addition Schedule
content:
Tenure lengthens the review grace days of an Apartment Home Lease: a lease in possession for 36 full calendar months or more adds 2 days, one in possession for 24 to 35 full calendar months adds 1 day, and a shorter tenure adds none.

| Full calendar months in possession on the handling date | Days added to the review grace days |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 2 |
| 24 to 35 | 1 |
| 23 or fewer | none |

**Counting tenure.** Full calendar months of tenure are counted from the move-in date (as the lease record shows it) to the same day number of a later month.

**Effect.** The added days lengthen the review grace days themselves, so the first late day of the review — the day after the last review grace day — moves later by the same number of days.

**Boundary dates (hypothetical move-in 20 January 2023).**

| Handling date | Full months | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 19 January 2025 | 23 | none |
| 20 January 2025 | 24 | 1 |
| 19 January 2026 | 35 | 1 |
| 20 January 2026 | 36 | 2 |

*Hypothetical:* with review grace days of 3 and a review clock starting on 1 May, a lease with 40 full months in possession has 5 review grace days (2 through 6 May) and a first late day of 7 May.
